newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, May 27, Santa Fe - no vessels berthed, no vessels due. max. draft 24 ft. 1 in. at access channel. Diamante - one vessel loading rice. no vessels due. max. draft 24 ft. 1 in. at passage km 520. San Lorenzo - five vessels berthed of which 2 loading SBMP, 1 loading soya, 1 loading maize, 1 loading sun pellets. 6 vessels in roads. 35 vessels due. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.15 metres during next week. Pasa berth draft, 18 ft. 6 in. fw. max. draft 32 ft. 0 in. fw high tide. Rosario - seven vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 under repairs, 2 discharging fertiliser, 1 loading sorghum. 2 vessels in roads. 10 vessels due. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.10 metres during next week. Max. draft 32 ft. 0 in fw high tide.

Villa Constitucion - two vessels alongside of which 1 loading WRC, 1 discharging iron ore. No vessels in roads. 1 vessel due. Elevator berths, max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. fw. San Nicolas - one vessel loading pig iron. 3 vessels in roads. 7 vessels due during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.15 metres during next week. Max. draft 33 ft. 04 in. fw high tide. San Pedro - one vessel loading maize. 1 vessel due. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.10 metres during next week. Max. draft 33 ft. 04 in. fw high tide.

Buenos Aires - fifteen vessels in port. 20 vessels due during the week. Max. Draft 31 ft. 6 in. high tide NAABSA (guided by entrance channel). Dock Sud max. draft 28/29 ft. fw. high tide NAABSA (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - four vessels berthed of which 1 loading wheat, 1 loading maize, 1 discharging urea. 7 vessels in roads. 20 vessels due during the week. Max. draft at entrance channal is 40 ft. 0 in. Bahia Blanca - six vessels berthed of which 3 loading maize, 2 loading wheat, 1 loading sunflower seeds. 2 vessels in roads. 7 vessels due during the week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, May 27, Vitoria - vessels berthed, 1 bulk malt discharger, 1 bulk soya loader, 2 container/general cargo loader/container, 1 pig iron loader, 1 steel products loader, 1 general cargo loader/discharger. Tubarao - 3 iron ore loaders, 1 fuel discharger. Praia Mole - 3 steel products loaders, 2 coal dischargers. Portocel/Ubu - no vessels. Twenty-one vessels waiting in roads. Santos - vessels berthed. 9 full container loaders/dischargers, 3 full container dischargers, 1 bulk cement, 1 wheat discharger, 2 bulk chemical products dischargers, 1 LPG discharger, 1 magnesium discharger, 1 general cargo loader/discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 bulk soya loader, 1 fertiliser discharger, 1 bulk pellets loader. 11 vessels waiting in roads. 82 vessels due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - 1 steel products loader. Ultrafertil - no vessels. Paranagua - vessels berthed, 2 container dischargers, 2 sugar loaders, 3 pellets loaders, 2 soya loaders, 3 general cargo loaders. 25 vessels waiting in roads of which 8 sugar for loader, 12 pellets for loader, 1 general cargo for loading, 3 soya for loading. 1 container for discharging. 37 vessels due during next 7 days.

Rio Grande - vessels berthed - 3 full container loaders, 1 soya loader, 1 soyabeans loader, 1 wheat discharger, 2 fertiliser dischargers, 1 ammonia discharger. 3 vessels waiting in roads. 23 vessels due during next 10 days.

Rio de Janeiro - vessels berthed, 1 wheat discharger, 2 general cargo/steel products dischargers. Tecon, 2 vessels. 30 vessels due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar, 4 vessels berthed. Commercial Quay, 1 vessel berthed. One vessel waiting in roads. 6 vessels due during next 7 days.
CHILE, May 26 - Arica - two vessels in port. 4 berths vacant. 7 vessels due during the week. Iquique - four vessels berthed working normally. 2 berths vacant. 11 vessels due during the week.
Antofagasta - four vessels berthed. 4 berths available. 13 vessels due during the week for loading and discharging conntrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo.
Valparaiso - eight vessels berthed working normally. 1 berth vacant. 1 berth out of service due to enlargement. 16 vessels due during the week. 1 days delay may be expected.

San Antonio - eight vessels operating. 2 berths vacant. 12 vessels due during the week. Port busy, but no waiting time. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - one vessel berthed. 1 vessel due. No vessels waiting in roads.

San Vicente - two vessels berthed operating normally. 6 vessels due during the week. 1 days berthing delay expected. Navy pier (MOLO 500)- 1 vessel berthed. No vessels due. Steel pier - 1 berth vacant. Coronel pier - 2 vessels berthed. 1 vessel due during the week. Oil terminal - 1 vessel berthed. 1 vessel due. Lirquen - three vessels berthed. 3 berths vacant. 9 vessels due during the week.

Penco - one vessel berthed. 1 vessel due during the week. Puerto Montt - two vessels in port. 1 passenger vessel. 5 vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - three vessels berthed. 9 vessels due during the week.

COLOMBIA, May 27 - Barranquilla - vessels berthed, 2 bulkers, 1 general cargo. Vessels due, 1 bulker, 5 containers, 4 general cargo. No waiting time. Cartagena - vessels berthed, 3 containers. Vessels due, 8 containers, 6 general cargo. No waiting time. Santa Marta - vessels berthed, 1 bulker, 1 container, 1 general cargo. Vessels due, 1 bulker, 6 containers, 7 general cargo. No waiting time.

Buenaventura - vessels berthed, 4 bulkers, 2 containers, 1 general cargo. Vessels anchored, 1 tanker, 1 general cargo. Due, 4 bulkers, 16 containers, 1 tanker, 3 general cargo, 1 pcc. Waiting time, 2 days bulkers, 1 day containers, 1 day tankers, 2 days general cargo.

PERU, May 27, Callao - seven vessels in bay, 8 in pier (general cargo/containers). No berthing delays. Paita, Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - no vessels. Talara - one oil vessel in pier. No berthing delays. Chimbote - three vessels in bay, 4 in pier (fishmeal). No berthing delays.
